import struct, zlib, collections
data = open('/tmp/validate_shot.png','rb').read()
# parse chunks
i = 8; idat = b''; w=h=bitdepth=colortype=None
while i < len(data):
    ln = struct.unpack('>I', data[i:i+4])[0]
    typ = data[i+4:i+8]
    chunk = data[i+8:i+8+ln]
    if typ == b'IHDR':
        w,h,bitdepth,colortype = struct.unpack('>IIBB', chunk[:10])
    elif typ == b'IDAT':
        idat += chunk
    i += 12 + ln
print('size:', w, h, 'bitdepth:', bitdepth, 'colortype:', colortype)
raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
ch = {0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[colortype]
stride = w*ch
# sample every 8th row
def paeth(a,b,c):
    p=a+b-c; pa=abs(p-a); pb=abs(p-b); pc=abs(p-c)
    return a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
px = []
for y in range(0, h, 7):
    rowstart = y*(stride+1)
    rowtype = raw[rowstart]
    row = raw[rowstart+1:rowstart+1+stride]
    prev = bytearray(stride)
    out = bytearray(stride)
    for x in range(stride):
        a = out[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0
        b = prev[x]
        c = prev[x-ch] if x>=ch else 0
        v = row[x]
        if rowtype==0: r=v
        elif rowtype==1: r=v+a
        elif rowtype==2: r=v+b
        elif rowtype==3: r=v+((a+b)>>1)
        else: r=v+paeth(a,b,c)
        out[x]=r&0xff
        prev[x]=out[x]
    px += list(out)
c = collections.Counter(px)
print('sampled pixels:', len(px), 'distinct color values (per channel):', len(c))
print('top color values:', c.most_common(6))
